items.title: Base creator Jesse Pollak says equities and non-dollar stablecoins will lead upcoming ‘tokenization supercycle’
items.summary: Coinbase launched tokenized stocks on Base six weeks ago, with about $70 million to $100 million in daily volume, according to Pollak.

items.title: Thailand SEC issues bitcoin and ether ETF rules set to take effect Oct. 16
items.summary: Thailand's SEC has limited initial crypto ETFs to bitcoin and ether, with new custody, exposure, and trading rules taking effect Oct. 16.

items.title: U.S. CFTC moves to fold event contracts into swaps regulations as legal fight rages
items.summary: The derivatives regulator is proposing a formal rule to include certain contracts traded on platforms like Kalshi's as swaps that require the agency's oversight.

items.title: French lawmakers back stablecoin swap tax in 2027 budget bill
items.summary: France’s Finance Committee backed taxes on stablecoin swaps, as well as unrealized crypto gains when households with more than 800,000 euros move abroad.

items.title: HSBC, Ant Digital test AI-agent payments using tokenized deposits
items.summary: The technical trial showed how AI agents could discover services and make micropayments using HSBC’s tokenized deposits, with real-time settlement and risk checks.

items.title: ESMA seeks evidence tokenized collateral can be cashed out in crisis
items.summary: ESMA is seeking industry feedback on the legal, liquidity and operational risks of tokenized collateral before deciding whether additional EU regulatory measures are necessary.

items.title: US Government Moves $1 Billion in Bitcoin Seized From Bitfinex Hacker
items.summary: A government wallet holding Bitcoin seized from the Bitfinex hacker sent 12,267 BTC to a new, unlabeled address, according to Arkham data.

items.title: Blockchain.com pursues CFTC approval for prediction markets: CNBC
items.summary: The crypto company has reportedly applied for two licenses with the US commodities regulatory as the courts weigh prediction markets cases.
